Class ServerRmi

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.ingsw.network.server.rmi.ServerRmi
All Implemented Interfaces:
DisconnectionListener, VirtualServerRmi, Serializable, Remote
public class ServerRmi extends UnicastRemoteObject implements VirtualServerRmi, DisconnectionListener
RMI server stub registered in the RMI registry under the name "GameServer".

Acts as the thin RMI transport layer between a remote ClientRmi and the shared MatchManager. Each incoming RMI call is validated at the transport level (exceptions declared by the interface) and then forwarded directly to the match manager.

Also implements DisconnectionListener so that ClientHandlerRmi can notify this object when a client's health check fails; the disconnection is then propagated to MatchManager.

      public void login(String nickname, VirtualViewRmi clientStub) throws RemoteException, InvalidUsernameException
      Registers a new RMI client session under the given nickname.

      Creates a ClientHandlerRmi for the new client, registers it with the match manager, and passes this as the DisconnectionListener so that health check failures are propagated back here.

    • handleDisconnection

      public void handleDisconnection(String nickname)
      Handles an involuntary disconnection for the given player, cleaning up their match or lobby state.

      Delegates to MatchManager.disconnect(String). Exceptions are intentionally swallowed here because disconnection callbacks must not throw checked exceptions.

      Specified by:

      Specified by:
